replacement_scope: rank-local no-label-smoothing CE backward from real saved FP32 softmax/mask/masked target and FP32 grad_output to FP32 local logits gradient

aliasing.real_source: Megatron aliases grad_input to saved-softmax and mutates it in place
aliasing.active_harness: grad_input is a separate preallocated contiguous FP32 buffer; reference copies softmax to it outside timing, then executes the exact Megatron helpers on grad_input. Candidate reads softmax and writes grad_input. softmax must remain read-only.
aliasing.forbidden: candidate must not rely on grad_input == softmax; passing overlapping input/output is rejected by the adapter

required_entry_point.prototype: extern "C" void ce_backward_local_fp32_stream(const float* softmax, const bool* target_mask, const int64_t* masked_target_1d, const float* grad_output, float* grad_input, int64_t rows, int64_t local_vocab, cudaStream_t stream);

inputs.softmax: FP32 contiguous [N,L], real normalized saved softmax, read-only
inputs.target_mask: bool contiguous [N], true iff target is not owned by rank, read-only
inputs.masked_target_1d: int64 contiguous [N], safe local index and zero when non-owning, read-only
inputs.grad_output: FP32 contiguous [N], upstream per-token loss gradient, read-only

output: FP32 contiguous [N,L] grad_input; owning row j=t: (softmax-1)*g; every other element and non-owning rows: softmax*g
dtype_layout: row-major contiguous; N=S*B; L=V/TP; all pointer alignment assumptions must be checked or safely handled
stream: launch only on supplied current PyTorch CUDA stream; no device-wide synchronization
workspace: none required; any implementation workspace must be caller-preallocated outside timing and explicitly added in a future contract
zero_collective_invariant: no NCCL, torch.distributed, process-group, or collective operation inside candidate boundary
